description: `new <name>` without `--yes` (and without `--dry-run`) refuses before touching the filesystem or calling Herdr, exit 1 (`new.rs` run(): `if !yes { return Err(Failure::Operation("new requires --yes to execute; use --dry-run to preview")) }`, new.rs:157-161) — this check runs after the config load and the non-empty/unregistered-target check, so a fresh, never-created target reaches it cleanly. Empty transcript asserts no Herdr call is made.

expect.stderr: new requires --yes to execute; use --dry-run to preview
